name: JWT Decoder
tagline: Offline JWT inspector, claim parser, and HS256/384/512 signature verifier.
description: Decode JSON Web Tokens 100% locally in your browser without pasting sensitive auth tokens into third-party websites. Inspect Header and Payload JSON, check expiration timestamps (exp/iat/nbf), and verify HMAC signatures using the native Web Crypto API.
changelog: v1.0.0 — Initial offline release with UTF-8 Base64URL decoding, claim timestamps, and Web Crypto HMAC verification
